title: To-Do List (ArrayList)
hints: Create the list once, before the loop, so it keeps its items between commands.
remove(item) returns true when the item was in the list. Use that to choose the message.
String.join(", ", items) builds "milk, eggs" for you.

mustContain.message: Store the items in an ArrayList.

tests.input:
6
add milk
add eggs
print
remove milk
count
print

Items: 1
